evals.prompt: Show me all my books sorted by rating, with columns for author, genre, and year published
evals.expected_output: DQL TABLE query with FROM #books or similar, SORT rating DESC, columns for author, genre, year

evals.prompt: I want to see all incomplete tasks that have a due date, grouped by the file they came from
evals.expected_output: DQL TASK query with WHERE !completed and due, GROUP BY file.link

evals.prompt: Write me a dataviewjs script that creates a table of all projects showing their status and days until deadline
evals.expected_output: dataviewjs code block with dv.table() and dv.pages(), calculating days until deadline

evals.prompt: Write a dataviewjs script that shows all my books grouped by genre, with each genre showing a count of books and average rating
evals.expected_output: dataviewjs code block using .groupBy() on DataArray, calculating count and average

evals.prompt: Write a dataviewjs script for my weekly review note that shows all tasks completed this week, grouped by the file they came from
evals.expected_output: dataviewjs code block using task.done field, dv.taskList(), and .groupBy()
